places.name: Senate Square & Helsinki Cathedral
places.ai_summary: A historic square featuring the iconic Helsinki Cathedral, surrounded by neoclassical buildings and a hub for cultural events.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited during daylight hours.

places.place_tip: Climb the cathedral steps for panoramic views of the square.

places.name: Suomenlinna Sea Fortress (UNESCO)
places.ai_summary: A UNESCO World Heritage Site, this sea fortress spans several islands and offers a glimpse into Finland's military history.

opening_hours.notes: Ferry schedules vary by season.

places.place_tip: Wear comfortable shoes for exploring the fortress grounds.

places.name: Market Square & Old Market Hall
places.ai_summary: A bustling market by the harbor offering fresh produce, local delicacies, and handmade crafts, alongside the historic Old Market Hall.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the morning for fresh produce.

places.place_tip: Try the salmon soup at the Old Market Hall.

places.name: Temppeliaukio Rock Church
places.ai_summary: Also known as the Stone Church, this architectural marvel is hewn into solid rock and is famous for its incredible acoustics.

opening_hours.notes: Concerts may affect visiting hours.

places.place_tip: Attend a concert for a unique acoustic experience.

places.name: Uspenski Cathedral
places.ai_summary: An Eastern Orthodox cathedral with stunning onion domes, offering insight into the Russian influence on Finnish architecture.

opening_hours.notes: Check for service times as the cathedral is active.

places.place_tip: Respect the dress code: shoulders and knees should be covered.

places.name: Esplanadi Park
places.ai_summary: A popular park in the city center, perfect for a leisurely stroll, with statues, fountains, and a bandstand.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the morning or late afternoon.

places.place_tip: Enjoy a coffee at one of the park's kiosks.

places.name: Kamppi Chapel of Silence
places.ai_summary: A chapel and community center in one, offering a quiet space in the bustling city, known for its modern architecture.

opening_hours.notes: Closed on public holidays.

places.place_tip: Experience the silence, it's a unique urban oasis.

places.name: Oodi Central Library
places.ai_summary: A modern architectural marvel, this central library is a hub of culture, offering books, events, and a unique design.

opening_hours.notes: Check event schedule for special openings.

places.place_tip: Visit the rooftop for a great view of the city.

places.name: Design District Helsinki
places.ai_summary: A vibrant area showcasing Finnish design, with boutiques, galleries, and studios, perfect for design enthusiasts.

opening_hours.notes: Check individual store hours.

places.place_tip: Visit the Design Museum for a deeper understanding of Finnish design.

places.name: Kiasma Museum of Contemporary Art
places.ai_summary: A modern art museum with a striking design, featuring contemporary art exhibitions and a popular café.

opening_hours.notes: Closed on Mondays from September to May.

places.place_tip: Don't miss the museum shop for unique design gifts.

places.name: Ateneum Art Museum
places.ai_summary: Finland's premier art museum, housing a vast collection of classical art, including works by Finnish and international masters.

opening_hours.notes: Closed on Mondays from September to May.

places.place_tip: Check out the museum café for a break with a view.

places.name: Seurasaari Open-Air Museum
places.ai_summary: An island museum showcasing Finnish rural life with historic buildings, farm animals, and traditional crafts.

opening_hours.notes: Closed on Mondays from September to May.

places.place_tip: Take the ferry from the Market Square for a scenic route.

places.name: Hietaniemi Beach
places.ai_summary: A popular city beach with sandy shores, beach volleyball courts, and a café, great for relaxation and sunbathing.

opening_hours.notes: Lifeguard services available during summer.

places.place_tip: Try the beach café's fresh pastries.

places.name: Helsinki Zoo (Korkeasaari Island)
places.ai_summary: Located on an island, this zoo focuses on conservation and education, featuring animals from cold climate regions.

opening_hours.notes: Closed on Mondays from September to May.

places.place_tip: Take the zoo train for a convenient tour of the island.

places.name: Linnanmäki Amusement Park
places.ai_summary: The oldest amusement park in Finland, offering a mix of thrilling rides, games, and entertainment for all ages.

opening_hours.notes: Opening hours vary by season.

places.place_tip: Try the funnel cake, a park specialty.

places.name: Allas Sea Pool & Sauna
places.ai_summary: A unique sea pool complex with saunas, offering a blend of relaxation and recreation in the heart of Helsinki.

opening_hours.notes: Check for special events and opening hours.

places.place_tip: Experience the traditional Finnish sauna.

places.name: SkyWheel Helsinki
places.ai_summary: A giant Ferris wheel offering panoramic views of Helsinki, the sea, and the surrounding archipelago.

opening_hours.notes: Weather permitting.

places.place_tip: Book a private cabin for a romantic experience.

places.name: National Museum of Finland
places.ai_summary: A museum dedicated to Finnish history and culture, featuring exhibitions from the Stone Age to the present day.

opening_hours.notes: Closed on Mondays from September to May.

places.place_tip: Join a guided tour for in-depth knowledge.

places.name: Kaivopuisto Park
places.ai_summary: A scenic park by the sea, popular for picnics, walks, and enjoying the views of the archipelago.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the morning or late afternoon.

places.place_tip: Visit the nearby Observatory Hill for a great view.

places.name: Ferry to Suomenlinna Island
places.ai_summary: A scenic ferry ride from Helsinki to Suomenlinna Island, a UNESCO World Heritage site and popular tourist destination.

opening_hours.notes: Check the schedule for return ferries.

places.place_tip: Buy a combination ticket for the ferry and fortress entrance.
